title: ONLINE LOBBY
subtitle: Your Clubs, and the rooms inside them. Auto refresh: 8s.
alias_hint: Give this server a name you recognize. Only you see this alias.
password_hint: Passwords stay only for this run. They are never saved or shared in invites.
choose: Choose a Club, or paste a full invitation below.
remove_hint: Remove this Club from your list? The server and its rooms stay online.
empty: Add your first Club to see its rooms.
no_rooms: No rooms yet. Select this Club to create one.
latency_hint: Room latency is the shared Club round trip. Older servers may not report ping. Scroll to browse all rooms.
stale: Last known rooms below. Refresh this Club before joining.
duplicate: This server is already in your Clubs. Select it to edit its alias.
password_long: A server password can contain up to 128 bytes.
limit: You can save up to 32 Clubs.
removed: This Club has been removed. Add it again to continue.
saved: Club saved. Its rooms refresh automatically.
